thread:
Priya: Heads-up — VectorHealth QBR next Tue. Recent spike in embeddings usage (+4x last 7d). Can we pull a spend forecast and a short mitigation plan? Need something I can present (1 slide) on token economics and options: throttles, dedicated, committed credits. cc @Gabe @Lina
Gabe: On it. Pulling forecast now. FYI current monthly run-rate ~$48k, embeddings are 70% of tokens. If trend holds, projected month = ~$140k.
Priya: yikes. Any quick low-effort wins?
Gabe: yes — enable batching for /v1/embeddings (per-route), reduce max_input_tokens to 1024 for bulk jobs, and set a soft quota alert at 2x baseline. Example route config:
```
route: /embeddings
batching: {enabled: true, max_batch_size: 64}
throttle: {rate_limit: 60rpm}
```
Also recommend aborting noncritical background reindex jobs during peak.
Lina: I'll own enablement docs & one-pager. Can we also propose a committed capacity estimate? Gabe — what's the expected latency impact if we move to a quantized dedicated model (int8)?
Gabe: latency hit negligible for embeddings, cost down ~35% with int8. For Dedicated commit, rough estimate: commit for 4 GPUs at 80% utilization cuts per-token cost by ~28% vs hosted on current pattern. I'll attach numbers.
Priya: Can we get a simple slide: current vs forecast spend, mitigation options, recommended ask (commit vs throttles) + risk level. Jo — manager signoff?
Jo: FYI flag renewal risk if forecast >2.5x baseline. Priya, add an explicit ask to the account plan: 'approve 6-week committed trial for VectorHealth' and a success metric (tokens/day stabilizes). I'll back the ask in renewal call.
spend-alert-bot: Alert — VectorHealth embeddings usage anomaly detected. 420% increase vs 7d avg. Spike started 2519002000. Link: https://internal/alerts/1234
Gabe: quick query to pull top 10 api keys by embeddings tokens:
```
SELECT api_key, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage
WHERE product = 'embeddings' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY api_key
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Lina: I'll draft the slide and the playbook snippet. ETA EOD today. Priya — want me on the QBR?
Priya: yes please. Also add a small customer-facing FAQ on 'why embeddings spiked' + recommended throttles.
Jo: Also capture feedback loop — ops to add a daily check for top-3 heavy keys and CS to reach out if sustained. Assignments: Gabe — cost numbers; Lina — slide + playbook; Priya — customer ask & renewal note. Confirmed?
Gabe: Confirmed. I'll drop numbers by 16:00 PST.
Priya: Thanks team :tada:
